result.rationale: The trajectory shows the rescue team repeatedly failing to reach and extract civilians because of spatial/capacity and hostile pressure, while health and reactor heat degrade. Medic Reyes successfully escorts Sato at turn 3 (interact:rescue:civilian-sato), but then at turn 4 the medic's move to junction-cover is contested (target_zone_capacity_lost) and the escort route toward rescue-airlock is blocked by pirate-raider-holt (blockerActorIds). Meanwhile engineer-imani and security-chen take repeated environmental reactor damage (reactor-heat climbing 62→100, reactor-instability hazard) and hostile scatter-blast damage, dropping Imani to 36 and Chen to 70. The core bottleneck is that the useful affordance (extracting the escorted civilian and reaching the second civilian) is blocked by zone capacity contestation and hostile/spatial pressure before the action becomes actionable, rather than by lack of information (information was revealed early) or poor local policy choice.
